independence_scope.dad_preflight_note: The local DAD connector/preflight command was not exposed to this subagent. Repository-local DAD and chunking policies were read; no DAD payload, write, promotion, or authority claim was attempted.

web.use: Received 66-book English coordinates and immediate discourse context only.

oshb.use: MT-order Hebrew/Aramaic surface, morphology, qere/ketiv tags, KJV-coordinate notes, and open/closed section markers as evidence only.

uxlc.use: Accented WLC-family surface, qere/ketiv, chapter numbering, and section-marker parity check only.

source_scope.correlation_warning: OSHB and UXLC are correlated Leningrad/WLC-family derivatives. Agreement between them confirms local transcription parity but is not an independent manuscript vote.
source_scope.roots_guard: Roots, lemma attributes, morphology codes, and Strong-style identifiers are locators or grammatical evidence only; roots are not meanings and none governs a boundary.

The WEB-to-MT mappings below are coordinate-alignment observations recoverable from the local WEB and OSHB/UXLC numbering. They are not a critical edition or a complete versional crosswalk.

versification_crosswalk.scope: Reference-label alignment only; never boundary, canon, witness, or preferred-reading authority.
versification_crosswalk.boundary_warning: WEB 5:31 is MT 6:1. The local data therefore exposes a real bridge question but cannot make either chapter tradition literary authority.

local_marker_inventory.surface_reset: Dan.1.17 begins with the four youths as a newly foregrounded group and a divine-gift statement.
Aramaic אדין דניאל לביתיה אזל changes location from court intervention to Daniel's house.
The one-verse fulfillment formula closes before the twelve-month realization scene.
WEB 4:34/MT 4:31 resumes first-person royal testimony after the narrated abasement.
WEB 5:31/MT 6:1 receives the kingdom; WEB 6:1/MT 6:2 begins the appointments.
Aramaic אדין צבית ליצבא opens Daniel's second, focused inquiry.
Dan.8.27 returns to first-person bodily and vocational aftermath.
A new exact day and river location begin at 10:4.
The restoration exchange closes and the messenger's purpose/conflict preface begins.
Counterevidence only: the same first-person speaker continues at 11:1, and ועַתָּה אֱמֶת אַגִּיד at 11:2 is the stronger disclosure opening.
ועשה כרצונו המלך begins a renewed royal portrait without naming a new actor.
ובעת ההיא explicitly continues the time frame across the chapter seam.
Verse 3 continues the wise-vindication culmination; verse 4 changes to direct address and sealing command.
Daniel's second question closes and a fresh direct answer begins.

review_method.proposal_scope: The fourteen requested seam clusters were independently replayed against the local WEB, OSHB, and UXLC surfaces before comparing the specialist's remedy.
review_method.larger_unit_rule: When correlated local sources do not resolve retrieval treatment, keep the larger coherent unit, lower confidence, and retain exact alternatives for boss/external-model/human review.
review_method.marker_rule: Pe, samekh, chapter, qere/ketiv, morphology, and versification are evidence only. A marker can corroborate a discourse reset but cannot create an independently useful chunk by itself.
review_method.macro_parent_rule: Every child remains hydrated inside the complete court-tale, dream/interpretation, vision/interpretation, or Dan.10.1-Dan.12.13 final-revelation parent.

seam_reviews.support: The request, ten-day test, observed comparison, and steward action close at 1:16. Verse 17 newly foregrounds all four youths, introduces their enablement, and leads to the appointed examination and service.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: No MT section marker occurs after 1:16, and both movements complete the chapter-one formation tale.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.1.8-Dan.1.21 as one child that obscures the test-to-enablement reset.

seam_reviews.support: A pe follows 2:16 in both correlated local views. Dan.2.17 changes location to Daniel's house and participants to the companions, beginning petition, revelation, and praise after the court intervention secured time.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: The household petition depends on the time obtained in 2:14-16, so the children must retain the complete dream-crisis parent.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.2.14-Dan.2.23 as one scene despite the marked court-to-house reset.

seam_reviews.support: WEB 4:28 is MT 4:25, the compact fulfillment formula כלא מטא על נבוכדנצר מלכא, and a pe follows it. WEB 4:29/MT 4:26 begins the twelve-month realization scene.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: The formula is anaphoric to the interpretation and prospective for the realization. The marker closes the formula but cannot decide backward attachment, forward attachment, or bridge hydration.

exact_remedy.alternate_route: Dan.4.19-Dan.4.28 followed by Dan.4.29-Dan.4.33 and Dan.4.34-Dan.4.37
exact_remedy.specific_hold_question: Should the pe-closed fulfillment formula at WEB 4:28 hydrate forward with realization, backward with interpretation, or bidirectionally while never surfacing alone?
exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Expose Dan.4.28 as a standalone one-verse chunk.

seam_reviews.support: WEB 4:33/MT 4:30 completes narrated abasement. WEB 4:34/MT 4:31 begins with a time-completion phrase and resumes first-person royal testimony, understanding, praise, and restoration.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: There is no MT section marker at this seam, and restoration is the reversal that completes the fulfillment arc.

exact_remedy.conditional_note: If the separate 4:28 hinge hold is resolved backward, use Dan.4.29-Dan.4.33 for the realization child.
exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.4.28-Dan.4.37 as one child that hides the narrated-abasement to first-person-restoration reset.

seam_reviews.support: A pe follows MT 5:30, which is also WEB 5:30. WEB 5:31 is MT 6:1 and supplies the regnal-receipt transition; WEB 6:1 is MT 6:2 and begins the appointments. This makes WEB 5:31 a genuine bridge between the completed feast reversal and the Darius setup.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: WEB assigns the bridge verse to chapter 5 while MT assigns it to chapter 6. OSHB and UXLC share the same WLC-family base and cannot independently decide which retrieval unit should own the bridge.

exact_remedy.specific_hold_question: Should WEB 5:31/MT 6:1 be owned by the feast coda, by the Darius setup, or by one bridge relation hydrated into both while exact coverage remains non-overlapping?
exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Let either chapter numbering tradition silently decide the seam.

seam_reviews.dissent: The peer prefers the cross-chapter Dan.5.31-Dan.6.9 setup child; the current baseline and the literary peer keep WEB 5:31 with the feast coda. Preserve both positions for boss review.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.7.15-18 contains distress, approach, request, and a concise general interpretation. Aramaic אדין צבית ליצבא at 7:19 explicitly opens a second, focused inquiry that receives the extended answer through 7:28.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: No MT section marker occurs after 7:18, and both exchanges interpret the same vision.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.7.15-Dan.7.28 as one undifferentiated interpretation block.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.8.27 returns to first-person illness, recovery, court work, astonishment, and non-understanding. Its dependence on the interpreted vision is confirmed by the absence of an MT section marker after 8:26 and the pe only after 8:27.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: Direct messenger speech ends at 8:26, so 8:27 is a formally distinct aftermath coda.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Expose Dan.8.27-Dan.8.27 as a standalone retrieval fragment.

seam_reviews.support: A pe follows 10:3. Dan.10.4 introduces a new exact day and river location, followed by the appearance, companion flight, weakness, hearing, and collapse.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: The three-week mourning prepares the encounter and is recalled in the subsequent explanation.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.10.1-Dan.10.9 as one child across the marked date-and-location reset.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.10.19 completes reassurance, strengthening, and Daniel's request that the speaker continue. Dan.10.20 begins a purpose/conflict preface with a fresh question and forward statement.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: No MT section marker occurs at the seam, and the same messenger continues speaking.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.10.10-Dan.11.1 as one child that obscures restoration dialogue versus disclosure preface.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.11.1 continues the same messenger's first-person self-report introduced in the preceding preface. Dan.11.2, with ועתה אמת אגיד לך, is the stronger opening of the detailed disclosure.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: A pe follows 10:21 and the MT/WEB chapter boundary falls there. Those are real section metadata, but they do not outweigh the cross-chapter speaker and function continuity for retrieval.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: End a child at 10:21 and begin another at 11:1 solely because of the pe and chapter label.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.11.35 closes with refining, the time of the end, and the appointed time. Dan.11.36 begins a renewed subject-action portrait, ועשה כרצונו המלך, which can support a discourse-movement seam without identifying the ruler.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: There is no MT section marker, no named new actor, and no speaker or scene reset. The local correlated sources cannot decide continuation versus pivot without risking an identity or historical inference.

exact_remedy.specific_hold_question: Can Dan.11.35|Dan.11.36 be defended solely as a discourse-movement seam while refusing every same-ruler, new-ruler, historical, and fulfillment inference?
exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Accept or reject the seam by deciding the ruler's identity.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.12.1 begins ובעת ההיא, 'at that time,' and repeats that temporal linkage inside the verse. It carries the preceding campaign end directly into trouble, deliverance, awakening, wise vindication, and the sealing command through 12:4.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: The chapter changes the immediate actor and introduces a recognizable culmination. That supports an internal submovement, not a top-level retrieval break under the larger-unit rule.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain separate Dan.11.36-Dan.11.45 and Dan.12.1-Dan.12.4 children merely because chapter 12 introduces a culmination.

seam_reviews.support: A samekh follows 12:2 and a pe follows 12:3, while 12:4 changes to direct address and sealing command. The local markers therefore identify internal articulation.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: Verse 3 continues the culmination's wise-vindication contrast, and verse 4 closes the disclosure addressed to Daniel. Turning 12:2, 12:3, or 12:4 into standalone retrieval chunks would amplify proof-texting risk and violate the larger-unit rule.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Expose Dan.12.1-2, Dan.12.3, or Dan.12.4 as independently retrievable atoms.

seam_reviews.dissent: The specialist allowed possible hydrated children at 12:1-2, 12:3, and 12:4. This peer records the markers but recommends annotation rather than three retrieval children.

seam_reviews.support: Dan.12.8 contains Daniel's second question and ends with a pe. Dan.12.9 begins the direct answer, sealing reminder, contrasts, numbered periods, and repeated personal dismissal through 12:13.
seam_reviews.counterevidence: Both exchanges share the riverbank vision and closing commission; the numbered periods must not be detached for calculation.

exact_remedy.rejected_alternative: Retain Dan.12.5-Dan.12.13 as one child that obscures the second question-answer reset, or isolate the numbered periods.

append_only_dissent_recommendations.question: Should WEB 5:31/MT 6:1 begin a cross-chapter Dan.5.31-Dan.6.9 setup child, rather than remain solely in a Dan.5.29-Dan.5.31 feast coda?
append_only_dissent_recommendations.peer_position: Prefer Dan.5.17-28, Dan.5.29-30, and Dan.5.31-6.9, with Dan.5.1-31 and Dan.5.31-6.28 hydration relations.
append_only_dissent_recommendations.other_position: Keep WEB 5:31 with the feast coda and begin the next child at WEB 6:1, while hydrating the bridge as needed.
append_only_dissent_recommendations.evidence_for_peer_position: MT begins chapter 6 at the verse corresponding to WEB 5:31; that verse names the receiving ruler, and WEB 6:1/MT 6:2 immediately begins his appointments.
append_only_dissent_recommendations.counterevidence_for_other_position: WEB 5:31 is the received-coordinate coda to the same-night fall, and no independent local witness can adjudicate the two numbering traditions.

append_only_dissent_recommendations.question: Should the section markers after Dan.12.2 and Dan.12.3 remain internal annotations rather than create retrievable children at Dan.12.1-2, Dan.12.3, and Dan.12.4?
append_only_dissent_recommendations.peer_position: Keep the larger culmination through 12:4; use marker annotations and mandatory hydration, never three independently surfaced fragments.
append_only_dissent_recommendations.other_position: Allow possible hydrated children at 12:1-2, 12:3, and 12:4 under the complete final-revelation parent.
append_only_dissent_recommendations.evidence_for_peer_position: Verse 3 continues the wise-vindication culmination, and verse 4 closes the same disclosure with a direct sealing command. The markers articulate the unit but do not make the one-verse spans independently sufficient.
append_only_dissent_recommendations.counterevidence_for_other_position: A samekh after 12:2, a pe after 12:3, and direct address at 12:4 are unusually strong local form indicators.

material_dissents: Prefer Dan.5.31-Dan.6.9 over keeping WEB 5:31 solely with the feast coda.
Record the Dan.12.2 and Dan.12.3 markers without exposing Dan.12.1-2, Dan.12.3, or Dan.12.4 as standalone children.
